criteria_verification.notes: Test test_no_spooling_to_disk patches tempfile.SpooledTemporaryFile to raise AssertionError and parse succeeds, proving no disk spooling. Independent test passed.
Test test_over_cap_body_lying_content_length creates oversized audio with misleading Content-Length and verifies RecordingTooLarge exception. Independent test passed.
Test test_missing_audio_field verifies ValueError('Missing required field: audio') when audio field absent. Independent test passed.

Parametrized test test_mime_variant_matrix verifies all 7 MIME variants pass: audio/ogg, audio/ogg;codecs=opus, audio/ogg; codecs=opus, audio/ogg;codecs="opus", AUDIO/OGG, audio/mp4, audio/webm;codecs=opus. Test test_unsupported_mime_type verifies rejection names received value. All 8 independent tests passed.

Test test_validation_order_pinning verifies size → empty → MIME → duration order. Tests test_duration_boundary_exactly_60_seconds (passes at 60s) and test_duration_boundary_just_over_60_seconds (raises QueryTooLong at 61s) verify boundaries. Test test_durationless_streamed_webm_passes verifies byte-cap-only. All 4 independent tests passed.
No lint/format errors reported. All quality gates passed. Code follows PEP 8 conventions with proper type hints and docstrings.
